# Jeremiah 51 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 51:64 (overlap: 12%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-say, 'Thus will-Babylon sink and-not rise, because-of the-evil which I am-bringing upon-her, and-they-will-be-weary.'" Thus far [are] the-words-of Jeremiah. |
| LOGOS | And say, 'Thus shall Babylon sink, to rise no more, because of the disaster that I am bringing upon her, and they shall become exhausted.'" Thus far are the words of Jeremiah. |
| PNEUMA | Then say, 'Just like this, Babylon and her people will sink — never to rise again — because of the disasters I will bring upon her.'" This is the end of Jeremiah's messages. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 51:6 (overlap: 12%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Flee from-the-midst-of Babylon, and-deliver each his-soul! Do-not-be-cut-off in-her-iniquity, for it-[is] a-time-of vengeance for-YHWH; a-recompense He-is-repaying to-her. |
| LOGOS | "Flee from the midst of Babylon; let every one save his life! Be not cut off in her punishment, for this is the time of the LORD's vengeance, the repayment He is rendering her. |
| PNEUMA | "Get out of Babylon! Run for your lives! Don't get trapped in her punishment! For it is the LORD's time of vengeance — He's paying her back for what she's done. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
